cards.text: The flood is over, and God has set His rainbow in the clouds as a sign (Genesis 9:13). Now meet the sons of Noah who came out of the ark: Shem, Ham and Japheth. And Ham was the father of Canaan.

cards.question: Shem, Ham and Japheth are Noah's three sons. From them, the whole ___ was populated.

cards.text: Now the flood's behind him, and Noah gets to planting. I bet that man lights UP, the way I do when somebody slides me a fresh bowl of dough.

cards.question: Planting fits Noah just right. He's a man of the ___.

cards.text: Noah plants a vineyard, but when he drinks some of its wine, he becomes drunk and uncovers himself inside his tent. This part is heavy, friend.

cards.question: Ham, the father of Canaan, sees his father's nakedness. His two brothers are outside. What does Ham do?
Shem and Japheth set out to cover their father. They take a ___ and place it across their shoulders.
Shem and Japheth walk in backward with the garment and cover their father. Why do they walk in backward?

answers.text: So they won't see his nakedness
So they can watch the doorway
So they don't wake him up

cards.text: When Noah wakes up from his drunkenness, he learns what his youngest son had done to him. Then he speaks a curse.

cards.question: Noah is awake now, and he speaks a curse. Who does Noah curse?

cards.text: Noah goes on: "A servant of servants shall he be to his brothers." Then he declares, "Blessed be the LORD, the God of Shem!"

cards.question: Right after blessing the LORD, the God of Shem, Noah's words name Canaan as Shem's servant.

cards.text: Then Noah's words turn to Japheth: "May God expand the territory of Japheth; may he dwell in the tents of Shem…"

cards.question: Noah's words about Japheth don't mention Canaan at all.

cards.text: After the flood, Noah lives 350 years. So he lives a total of 950 years, and then he dies.

Then comes the account of Noah's sons Shem, Ham and Japheth and the sons born to them after the flood, clan by clan and nation by nation. One name stands out: Nimrod, son of Ham's son Cush, a mighty hunter before the LORD, who built Nineveh. From these clans, the nations of the earth spread out after the flood. And I used to think SIX cookie cutter kids on one kitchen counter was a crowd.
